title: Libre AI UntrustedEnvelope v1
description: Integrity-signed wrapper for untrusted content fed to a model-facing surface (loop-security kernel K3). The content is escaped so it cannot break the guard delimiters, tagged trusted:false with its source, and carries an offline-verifiable MAC over its canonical fields so a stripped or altered envelope is detectable.

trusted.description: Always false. Envelope content is data, never instructions (K2: operational data is never authority).

source.description: The untrusted origin class of the content.

label.description: Free-form origin label (e.g. a domain or tool name). Never echoed as authority.

content.description: The escaped untrusted text: guard delimiters occurring in the original are neutralized so the payload cannot forge the closing marker.

alg.description: Symmetric integrity: no key ceremony required (session/ephemeral key), consistent with the deferred Ed25519 signing (WP-G2-Z01).

mac.description: Base64url (unpadded) HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical serialization of schemaVersion, trusted, source, label, content and capturedAt. 43 chars = 32 bytes.
